noAccess.title: You cannot see the bank
noAccess.body: The bank's statements and lines need the right to see the company's bank (payments.bank.view). Ask an administrator.

band.label: Bank
band.refreshed_one: Looked again: {count} line has new suggestions.
band.refreshed_other: Looked again: {count} lines have new suggestions.

tile.title: Bank
tile.TO_MATCHHint: Money in and out not matched yet
tile.SUREHint: A High suggestion waits for your yes

match.title: Match bank lines
match.hint: The line on the left, its suggested invoices on the right with how sure and why. Amounts are prices.
match.noPrice: Amounts are not shown: your role does not see selling prices.

refusal.items: One of the items is no longer open for this customer: choose again.
refusal.recorded: This bank reference is recorded already as a payment: choose that payment instead of recording it again.
refusal.together: These matches cannot be accepted together (one changed, or two are for the same line): read them again.

statement.clear: Show the lines to match instead of this statement

empty.title: Every bank line is matched
empty.body: Import the next statement when it comes from the bank.

none.title: No lines here
none.body: No bank line is in this view now.

difference.UNDERPAYMENT: Accepting leaves {amount} unpaid on the invoice.
difference.OVERPAYMENT: Accepting leaves {amount} not placed: it stays on the customer's account.

refusal.NO_TOLERANCE: The company has no write-off tolerance set (the accountant's, in the receivables settings): nothing is written off.
refusal.OVER_TOLERANCE: The difference is above the write-off tolerance: it is not written off.
refusal.NOTHING_LEFT: Nothing is left to write off.
refusal.SHORT_ON_SEVERAL: The money is short on more than one invoice: choose how much goes on each instead.
refusal.SHORT_ON_DEPOSIT: A deposit request is short: it is not written off.
refusal.NOTE_NEEDED: Say why it is written off.
refusal.NOT_RECEIVED: The payment is not received (voided): nothing is written off.
refusal.NOT_AN_INVOICE_ALLOCATION: Only a difference on an invoice is written off.
refusal.REVERSED_ALREADY: This write-off is taken back already.
refusal.A_REVERSAL: A taking-back is not taken back again.
refusal.other: The difference cannot be written off.

panel.label: The open bank line and its suggestions
panel.title: Line of {date}
panel.nothing: No line to open in this view.
panel.pick: Open a line from the list to see its suggestions.
panel.stale: Paid meanwhile: it cannot be accepted (the next look removes it).

noSuggestion.title: No suggestion for this line
noSuggestion.bodyIn: Choose the customer and the invoices it pays.
noSuggestion.bodyOut: No supplier invoice matches it yet.

panel.acceptedRecorded: Match accepted: the payment is recorded and placed.

period.soft: This day falls in a month closed softly.
period.hard: This day falls in a month closed for good: it cannot be written; ask the accountant.
period.softAsk: The month is closed softly: say why this goes in, then send again.
period.reason: Why it goes into the closed month

choose.title: Choose another or split
choose.writeOff: Write off what is left instead (within the tolerance)
choose.writeOffHint: Written off only when the whole difference is within the company's tolerance.
choose.goSplit_one: Split over {count} item and record the payment
choose.goSplit_other: Split over {count} items and record the payment

held.items: Tick at least one invoice or deposit request.
held.amounts: Fix the amounts first: together they may not pass the line.

reverse.title: Take back this acceptance?
reverse.body: The line goes back to match, with its suggestions.
reverse.bodyRecorded: The placements and any write-off are taken back, the payment it recorded is voided, and the line goes back to match.
reverse.held: Say why it is taken back.
reverse.done: Acceptance taken back: the line is to match again.

review.summary_one: Nexus only: {count} payment is recorded and placed; nothing goes to the bank. All or none.
review.summary_other: Nexus only: {count} payments are recorded and placed; nothing goes to the bank. All or none.
review.summaryMore_one: The first {count} sure match (at most 50 at a time). Nexus only; all or none.
review.summaryMore_other: The first {count} sure matches (at most 50 at a time). Nexus only; all or none.

held.busy: Wait: the last action is still running.
held.match: You can see the bank, not match its lines (payments.bank.match).
held.record: Accepting money in records a payment: that needs payments.record.
held.void: Taking it back voids the payment it recorded: that needs payments.void.
held.writeOffNote: Say why it is written off.
held.lockReason: Say why it goes into the closed month.
held.import: You can see the bank, not import statements (payments.bank.import).
held.upload: Importing a file needs the right to upload files (files.upload).
held.stale: An item it names was paid meanwhile: look again or choose another.
held.currency: Payments are recorded in euro: this line is in {currency}. Record it by hand.
held.chooseOut: Money out is matched from its suggestion; a supplier invoice cannot be chosen by hand here yet.
held.parties: Choosing a customer needs the right to see customers (parties.view).
held.price: Choosing the amounts needs the price grain (money.price).
held.leave: A line cannot be set aside yet (bank charges, salaries): it stays to match until a step adds that.
held.noSure: No sure match to accept in this view.
held.skipErrors_one: {count} line cannot be read: tick to import without it, or fix the mapping.
held.skipErrors_other: {count} lines cannot be read: tick to import without them, or fix the mapping.
held.figures: You can see their figures, not record them (receivables.theirFigures.manage).
held.figuresPrice: Their figures are prices: typing them needs the price grain (money.price).
held.filesRead: Opening the file needs the right to read files (files.read).
held.pasteNothing: Paste rows first (each ending with an amount).

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.open: Open the line beside the list
keys.accept: In the panel: accept the suggestion
keys.split: In the panel: choose another or split

import.title: Import a bank statement
import.fileBody: The statement you downloaded from the bank's site: camt.053 (XML), CSV, Excel or OFX. A line imported before is never imported again.
import.fileHint: camt.053, CSV, XLSX or OFX · at most 10 MB
import.formatPick: Say which format the file is
import.accountSheet: A sheet names no account: choose it.
import.accountFile: The file names its account; choose one only to check it.

held.format: Say which format the file is.
held.account: Choose the account this sheet is for.

import.mappingBody: Say which column holds what. The booking day and the amount (or money in and money out) are needed.

mapping.needAmount: Map the amount, or money in and money out.
mapping.incomplete: Map the booking day and the amount first.

import.duplicates: Lines imported before are left out: never twice.
import.skipErrors_one: Import without the {count} line that cannot be read
import.skipErrors_other: Import without the {count} lines that cannot be read

problem.BAD_DATE: The day is not a date.
problem.FUTURE_DATE: The booking day has not come yet.
problem.BAD_AMOUNT: The amount is not a number in the format chosen.
problem.TOO_MANY_DECIMALS: Too many decimals for the currency.
problem.BOTH_SIDES: An amount both in and out.
problem.REFERENCE_TOO_LONG: The bank reference is longer than 100 characters.

import.first200: The first 200 of {count} lines are shown.

done.body: {suggested} suggestions found; {duplicate} lines were imported before and left out.

refusal.FORMAT_UNKNOWN: Say which format the file is: camt.053 (XML), CSV, Excel or OFX.
refusal.FILE_NOT_READY: The file is not ready: upload it again.
refusal.NOT_A_STATEMENT_FILE: This file was not uploaded as a bank statement of this company.
refusal.ACCOUNT_NEEDED: The file names no account: choose the bank account it is for.
refusal.ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: The file is for an account the company does not have (or has switched off).
refusal.ACCOUNT_DIFFERS: The file is for another account than the one chosen.
refusal.ACCOUNT_OFF: The account chosen is switched off: nothing is imported into it.
refusal.CURRENCY_DIFFERS: The file is in another currency than the account's.
refusal.MAPPING_INCOMPLETE: Map the booking day and the amount (or money in and money out) first.
refusal.NOTHING_NEW: Every line of this file is imported already: nothing new.
refusal.LINES_UNREADABLE: Some lines cannot be read: fix the mapping, or import without them.
refusal.CHANGED_SINCE_DRY_RUN: The lines changed since the check (another import took some): check the file again.

file.UNREADABLE: We could not read this file.
file.NOT_THIS_FORMAT: This file is not in the format chosen.
file.NO_LINES: The file has no booked movement.
file.TOO_MANY_LINES: The file has too many movements (or is over 10 MB): download a shorter period.
file.SEVERAL_ACCOUNTS: The file holds more than one account: download one account at a time.
file.sheet: We could not read this sheet: check its format and its sheet.

figures.title: Their figures vs ours
figures.hint: A B2B customer's own statement compared with our books as of the same day. Amounts are prices.
figures.noPrice: Amounts are not shown: your role does not see selling prices. Which lines differ is still said.
figures.failed: Couldn't load their figures vs ours

empty.title: No customer figures recorded
empty.body: When a customer sends its own statement, record its figures here to see every difference.

noAccess.title: You cannot see customers' figures
noAccess.body: Their figures need the right to see receivables (receivables.view).

figures.detailTitle: Their figures vs ours — {customer}, as of {date}
figures.balanceHint: Ours: invoices − credit notes − payments + refunds paid as of the day, small differences written off counted. The difference is theirs − ours.
figures.noOrders: They listed no order, and nothing is open with us.
figures.paymentsFrom: Our payments are compared from {date}, the first payment they list.
figures.paymentsNone: They listed no payment: ours are not compared one by one (the balance says the whole difference).
figures.newBody: Type what the customer's statement says as of its day: per order, the payments it made and its balance. They are compared with our books at once.
figures.correctBody: Correct a typing mistake. The customer stays the same; the figures are never deleted.
figures.asOfHint: The day their statement is as of (not after today).
figures.balanceTyped: What they say they owe us (below 0: what we owe them).
figures.pasteOrdersHint: One order per line: reference, then amount (tab or ; between them)
figures.pastePaymentsHint: One payment per line: reference, day, amount (tab or ; between them)
figures.noPaymentsTyped: No payment typed: add the ones they list.
figures.fileHint: The statement as they sent it (PDF, sheet…), kept with these figures.
figures.recordedNotice: Their figures are recorded and compared.
figures.correctedNotice: Their figures are corrected and compared again.

problem.asOfMissing: Choose the day of their statement.
problem.asOf: Their figures are as of a day that has come (not after today).
problem.date: A payment they list comes after the day of their figures.
problem.note: A note of at most 2000 characters.

refusal.NOT_A_CUSTOMER: This party is not a customer: only a customer's figures are compared.
refusal.AMOUNT_NEEDED: Every order, every payment and the balance need their amount.
refusal.FILE_NOT_READY: Their statement's file is not ready: upload it again.
refusal.NOT_A_FIGURES_FILE: This file was not uploaded as a customer's statement of this company.
refusal.FILE_USED: This file is kept with other figures already.
refusal.REFUSED: These figures cannot be kept as typed: check the day, the references and the amounts.

read.signed_out: You are signed out: sign in again.
read.not_found: It is not there any more.
read.unavailable: The server does not answer now: try again in a moment.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment and try again.
read.internal: Something went wrong on our side: try again.

write.moved: Someone changed it meanwhile: it is read again; check and send again.
write.state: It cannot be done in its present state: it is read again.
write.invalid: Something typed is not valid: check the fields.
write.signed_out: You are signed out: sign in again.
write.not_found: It is not there any more.
write.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment and try again.
write.unavailable: The server does not answer now: try again in a moment.
write.step_up: Confirm with a fresh code first.
write.internal: Something went wrong on our side: nothing was changed.
